title: Define pod adaptive snapshot with atomic double buffer publication
description:
Create Source/Analysis/AdaptiveSnapshot.h only. This is a header-only, fixed-size POD snapshot plus a double-buffered publisher used to cross from the message/control path to the audio thread.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Analysis/ (existing analyzer, onset, density, sustain, and controller headers) to reuse existing naming, namespace, and include conventions.
- Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h for the per-voice destination names and value ranges the snapshot must carry.
- Source/PluginProcessor.h for the namespace and header include style used across the project.

Define, inside the project's existing analysis namespace:
1. `struct AdaptiveSnapshot` - a trivially copyable POD aggregate with NO strings, NO std::string, NO pointers to heap data, NO shared_ptr, NO virtual functions, NO dynamically sized containers. Fields: `float contraction` (0.0f..1.0f), `float bloom` (0.0f..1.0f), `int mode` (0 = Off, 1 = Articulation, and remaining existing adaptive mode enumerators encoded as ints), and a fixed-size C array `AdaptiveVoiceDeltas voices[kAdaptiveVoiceCount]` with `static constexpr int kAdaptiveVoiceCount = 2;`.
2. `struct AdaptiveVoiceDeltas` - POD with `float wetLevelDeltaDb`, `float t60OctaveDelta`, `float lpfOctaveDelta`, `float widthDelta`, `float softeningDelta`, `float diffusionDelta`. All default-initialized to 0.0f so a default-constructed snapshot is the exact identity (no adaptation).
3. `class AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher` - owns exactly two preallocated `AdaptiveSnapshot` members (a C array of size 2, never heap-allocated, never resized), a `std::atomic<int> activeIndex` and a `std::atomic<std::uint32_t> generation`. Methods:
   - `void publish (const AdaptiveSnapshot& next) noexcept` - writes into the inactive buffer, then stores the new active index and increments the generation using `std::memory_order_release`.
   - `bool read (AdaptiveSnapshot& destination) const noexcept` - loads the active index and generation with `std::memory_order_acquire`, copies the POD by value into `destination`, returns true when the generation observed before and after the copy match, false otherwise (caller keeps its previous snapshot on false).
   - `std::uint32_t currentGeneration() const noexcept`.
   All methods must be allocation-free, lock-free, and callable from the audio thread. `read` must not allocate, must not construct strings, and must not destroy heap-owned objects.

Add `static_assert (std::is_trivially_copyable<AdaptiveSnapshot>::value, ...)` and `static_assert (std::is_standard_layout<AdaptiveSnapshot>::value, ...)` in the header so violations fail at compile time.

Do not modify DelayVoice, PluginProcessor, CMakeLists.txt, or anything under JUCE/. Do not add any third-party dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Analysis/AdaptiveSnapshot.h exists and declares struct AdaptiveSnapshot, struct AdaptiveVoiceDeltas, and class AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher
AdaptiveVoiceDeltas contains wetLevelDeltaDb, t60OctaveDelta, lpfOctaveDelta, widthDelta, softeningDelta, and diffusionDelta, all defaulted to 0.0f

AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher holds exactly two preallocated AdaptiveSnapshot buffers plus std::atomic active index and std::atomic generation counter, with no heap allocation and no std::shared_ptr anywhere in the header
publish uses std::memory_order_release and read uses std::memory_order_acquire, and read returns false when the generation changes mid-copy
Source/Analysis/AdaptiveSnapshot.h contains static_assert checks that AdaptiveSnapshot is trivially copyable and standard layout
cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_VST3 succeeds after this change
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: use std::atomic<std::shared_ptr> or any shared_ptr for cross-thread publication
store std::string, juce::String, or any heap-owning member inside AdaptiveSnapshot
add locks, mutexes, or dynamic allocation to publish or read
reference artist or song names in source or comments

allowed: choose header include guard or #pragma once consistent with existing Source/Analysis headers
choose exact field ordering within the POD structs
forbidden: introduce a new cross-thread messaging framework
change the DelayVoice or PluginProcessor interfaces
define adaptive mode as an enum class that changes existing mode encodings
